plugin.2110_io.disruptive_confirm: This operation will briefly cut ALL the engine's flows.
plugin.2110_io.not_subscribed_tip: Slot not subscribed — no flow and no generator (empty output)
plugin.2110_io.realign_tip: One or more sources are subscribed but receive no flow. Redeploying the engine realigns the queues (brief cut of ALL flows).
plugin.2110_io.st_inactive_tip: No subscription on this flow: nothing is requested from the source.
plugin.2110_io.st_mute_tip: Subscribed, but no sample is arriving: the source is silent or absent.
plugin.2110_io.st_noflux_tip: Subscribed (IS-05) but no flow is coming back: RX creation failed (node lcore budget) or no network traffic (source/switch).
plugin.2110_io.st_subscribed_tip: Subscribed, but no frame is coming back yet.
